title: Monique Langhorne Wilson
intro:
Monique Langhorne Wilson is a judge for Division 1 of the California 1st District Court of Appeal. She assumed office on January 30, 2024. Her current term ends on January 4, 2027.
Langhorne Wilson is running for re-election for the Division 1 judge of the California 1st District Court of Appeal. She is on the ballot in the retention election on November 3, 2026.
